entries.title: Length of Longest V-Shaped Diagonal Segment
entries.whyTime: The loops over the m·n cells start `dfs` from each cell in each of 4 directions: O(m·n) calls. `dfs` computes each (cell, direction, turn used) state once, with a fixed number of states per cell: O(m·n) states at O(1) each. Time is O(m·n).
entries.whySpace: `memo` holds a fixed number of states per cell, m·n cells: O(m·n) entries. The `dfs` recursion goes up to m + n calls deep. The sum is O(m·n + m + n), and m + n drops because m·n grows at least as fast. Space is O(m·n).

entries.title: Minimum Cost Path with Edge Reversals
entries.whyTime: Building `adj` adds each of the E edges and its reversed move at twice the cost: O(E). The Dijkstra loop pushes onto `heap` O(E) times and pops O(E) times, each at O(log E): O(E log E). The sum is O(E log E + E), and E drops because E log E grows at least as fast. Since E ≤ V², log E is O(log V), so the sum is O(E log V). Time is O(E log V).
entries.whySpace: `adj` holds O(E) entries. `dist` holds one entry per reached node, up to V. `heap` holds O(E) entries. Space is O(V+E).

entries.title: Arbitrage
entries.whyTime: The loop over V rounds passes over all E rates, relaxing each in O(1) with `-log(rate)` computed inline: O(V·E). One more pass over the E rates detects any improvement: O(E). The sum is O(V·E + E), and E drops because V·E grows at least as fast. Time is O(V·E).
entries.whySpace: `dist` holds one value per currency: V entries. The `rates` input is not counted. Space is O(V).

entries.title: Island Hopping
entries.whyTime: Setting up `dist` is O(n). The loop runs n rounds. Each round scans the islands for the nearest unconnected one: O(n). Each round also updates the distances to the rest: O(n). That is O(n²) over all rounds. The sum is O(n + n²), and n drops because n² grows at least as fast. Time is O(n²).
entries.whySpace: `dist` holds n values. `connected` holds n flags. Space is O(n).
